text.content:
Food, drink, and Roxanne Lawrence's sponsor since 2047.

Headquarters: Continental Brands (#57), Downtown
Industry: Food, drink and consumer goods
In Night City: Owns the housing block across from its headquarters that Danger Gal rented as the Danger Zone
Known for: Backing Roxanne Lawrence for over twenty years

A consumer goods giant with its headquarters in Downtown, guarded by its own security. Across the street stands the housing block Danger Gal rented for decades as the Danger Zone, its pink-carpeted headquarters and staff housing; it has been emptied of cat girls and renamed Flavors of the World again.

Continental had nothing to do with the 2047 wedding. In the years after it, though, it backed Roxanne Lawrence everywhere she went: sponsorships, appearances, security and a foundation in her name. It doesn't discuss why.

GM secrets

Lyle Thompson believes Continental was one of the hands that helped end Static Night, and that Roxanne is how it keeps the account open. Which Roxanne it is backing, the bride or the double, he can't say.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02, 05, 07
